tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ro snyoms khrid kyi sa bcad bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// 'dir rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying phyung ba// rje btsun nā ro pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ zhal gyi bdud rtsi/ nad 'don rtog pa lam khyer/ ro snyoms skor drug gi gdams ngag 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ yid ches shing khung btsun par byed pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdam pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pa'o// gnyis pa la rgyu snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rnam rtog lam du khyer ba ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i gdams ngag nyon mongs pa lam du khyer ba dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag lha 'dre lam du khyer ba bar chad dngos grub tu sdud pa'i gdams ngag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lam du khyer ba byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag na tsha lam du khyer ba 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdam ngag /'chi ba lam du khyer ba ma bu ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag dang drug go /dang po la/ dbang po tha ma gzigs mo bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang ba dang*/ dbang po 'bring rnam shes 'khyam po dang srid pa gsum gyi ngo sprod byas la nyams su blang ba/ dbang po rab dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo sprod byas la rang res rang re ngo shes par bya ba dang gsum mo// dang po la/ nyan thos kyi lta stangs/ seng ge'i/ khro bo'i/ ma hā de ba'i lta stangs so// gnyis pa la ngo sprod pa dang*/ nyams su len pa gnyis/ dang po la rnam shes 'khyam po la brten nas phung mkhan ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi ngo sprod de/ gnyis pa nyon mongs lam khyer la/

dbang po rab kyi nyams len/ 'bring gi tha ma'i nyams len no// dang po la yang rab dang*/ rab kyi nyams len gnyis/ gnyis pa dbang po 'bring la dmigs pa spro ba dang*/ zlog sgom mo/ gsum pa la/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab sgom pa'o// lha 'dre lam khyer la/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ gsang ba'i spyod pa/ tshogs kyi spyod pa/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa dang bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po la gos su ci bgo ba/ rgyan du ci gdags pa/ zas su gang za ba/ grogs su gang bkri ba/ cho ga gsum bya ba'o// dngos gzhi la/ gnas gang du 'gro ba/ spyod lam ji lta bus 'gro ba/ spyod pa ji ltar bya ba dang bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ spros bcas/ spros med/ shin tu spros med gsum mo// rjes la/ zhal gdams rjes 'dzin gnyis/ zhal gdams la/ blos rtags/ lam khyer/ spobs chog chod rtag tshar tshad do// tshogs spyod la/ rgyan du ci gdags pa/ gos su gang bgo ba/ lus la ji ltar bya ba/ lus slong ba byung na ji ltar bya ba/ dus dang zas ci za ba/ rang gi gzugs cir bsgyur ba/ grogs gang bkri ba/ lag char ci khyer ba/ dam tshig gang bsrung ba/ spyod pa gsum las gang bya ba/ sdug bsngal lam khyer la/ tha mas bde sdug las su sgom pa/ 'bring gis bde sdug yid kyis brje ba/ rab kyis bde sdug dngos su brje ba'o// gnyis pa la/ bdag gzhan sgom pa dang*/ yid kyis bde sdug brje ba'o// na tsha lam khyer la/ nad ngos bzung ba/ gsor rung mi rung gi dmigs bsal bstan pa/ nad 'don pa dang gsum mo// dang po la/ bshad pa'i ngos 'dzin rnam pa lnga/ ngo sprod ngos 'dzin rnam pa lnga/ mdor bsdus ngos 'dzin rnam pa gnyis so// gsum pa nad 'don la/ spyi'i nad 'don/ bye brag so so'i nad 'don/ nad 'don gyi mjug bsdu ba'o/

dang po la rab lta bas 'don pa/ 'bring sgom pas 'don pa/ tha ma lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis 'don pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ yang rab gnyen po dang bral ba/ rab gnyen po dang 'brel ba'o// gnyis pa la ro snyoms bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnyen po mkha' 'gro sde bzhi/ dmigs pa chos nyid skor gsum/ nad 'don gyi dmigs phran brten pa dang bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ dmigs phran dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i gtum mo nyi zla drug skor ro// bye brag so so'i nad 'don la/ lha 'dre'i nad 'don dang*/ rang bzhin gyi nad 'don gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad 'don/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyi nad 'don/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad 'don/ rnam rtog gi nad 'don no// 'chi ba lam khyer la/ dbang po rab 'od gsal la 'phos pa mngon dga'i sa/ 'bring sgyu lus la 'phos pa dus kyi sa/ tha ma bskyed rim la 'phos pa skye ba 'dzin pa'i sa'o// rjes la/ rlung gi gegs sel yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ gegs sel bka' rgya ma'o// khrid kyis sa bcad 'di nyid gong ma'i gsung mi 'phyugs pa'i ched du pad+ma dkar pos bris pas/ nyams khrid ma thob pa la dpe dam du gyis shig /
